bm25_implementation: existing ax_research.retrieval.bm25.BM25Retriever; KiwiTokenizer; BM25Okapi unchanged defaults
document_text: [PROBLEM] raw_problem newline [TASK] raw_task newline [CONTEXT] raw_context; exactly old Stage2
perspective_query: exact saved branch_query = title newline description; no original-query append or query expansion
dynamic_outer_operator: arithmetic mean across perspectives for every condition; Dense-only mean(1/(60+dense_rank)); hybrid mean(per_path_hybrid)
no_double_rrf: Do not replace per_path_hybrid by reciprocal hybrid rank before outer mean; hybrid branch rank is exported for provenance only.
effective_dynamic_path_weights: each perspective Dense1/(2M),BM251/(2M); total Dense0.5,BM250.5 independent of M
tie_break: case_id_ascending for all ranks, including BM25 zero-score ties; record tie diagnostics, no tie-policy tuning
arithmetic: exact Fraction RRF; export exact and decimal scores

primary.D: dynamic Single Dense, same mean-RRF outer as F

historical_rr_and_original_anchor: reference only; not used as matched Dense controls for hybrid treatment
aggregation: three generation repeats averaged within each original query then Macro; original deterministic rankings evaluated once
mapping_export: normalized query registry, case PTC registry and full112 retrieval feature rows; no Silver/median/labels in future mapping input features
